title: 2020 and 2021: GraphQL, OAST, and retesting
description: Student Hall of Fame entries for 2020-2021 GSoC and Season of Docs: GraphQL support, OAST, and retesting alerts
narrative:
Each of these projects probably left a trail of commits, a blog post and an add-on. The ZAP Student Hall of Fame is the public listing that credits their creators. Akshath Kothari is listed for GraphQL Support (2020) and for Out-of-band Application Security Testing (2021). A third entry, Retesting Alerts, belongs to Pranav Saxena (2021).

The first commit to the GraphQL add-on is dated May 2020, and the first commit to OAST is dated June 2021. Retesting Alerts starts with an initial add-on dated August 2021. Those commits probably mark where each add-on began rather than when it was first released.

For a small team, the first commit is probably the easiest record to point to when a student's work is credited. For a reader tracing where a feature began, that is probably the most useful date. Each of the three projects has its own story in the atlas, which follows each add-on's later history.
